name: Plate Pinch Hold
summary: A static hold that trains the thumb and finger pinch grip by holding weight plates together smooth side out.
setup: Stack two light plates with the smooth sides facing out.
Stand with your arm at your side and pinch the plates between your fingers and thumb.
Keep the wrist neutral and shoulders relaxed.
execution: Lift the plates off the floor or bench by pinching them together.
Hold them at your side for the target time.
Keep the wrist neutral and breathe normally.
Lower the plates under control and rest before the next set.
mistakes: Using too heavy a stack: start light so you can hold for the full time.
Letting the wrist bend: keep it in line with the forearm.
Shrugging the shoulder: keep it relaxed.
Dropping the plates: lower them under control to protect your fingers and toes.
